method: Score weights assumed equal; compare Z weighting by sqrt(2p(1-p)) versus 1/SE, with same target marginal beta/SE and JPT reference LD; cross-chromosome correlations zero.
caveat: Postselected exploratory analysis. Inverse-SE assumes these marginal standard errors and external LD approximate the target score-statistic covariance; source imbalance, imputation, sample overlap, low case counts and target LD can invalidate either approximation. Not a patient-level score test, association confidence interval, or clinical validation.
